job: Reserve and ramp the LPU-v3 Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B dedicated capacity pool so the $0.31 per million floor and 0.082 second cold-start hold under OpenRouter routed volume.
job_ja: LPU-v3のQwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B専用キャパシティ枠を確保し増設し、OpenRouter経由の流入下でも100万トークンあたり0.31ドルの下限価格と0.082秒のコールドスタートを維持できるようにする。
job_es: Reservar y escalar el pool dedicado de capacidad LPU-v3 para Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B para que el piso de $0.31 por millon y el cold-start de 0.082 segundos se sostengan bajo el volumen enrutado de OpenRouter.
job_fil: Magreserba at mag-ramp ng dedikadong LPU-v3 capacity pool para sa Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B upang manatili ang $0.31 per million floor at 0.082 segundo cold-start sa ilalim ng OpenRouter routed volume.
outcome: A weekly-refreshed LPU-v3 capacity ledger pinning at least 38,420 tokens-per-second per rack for Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B across the 18 sites with the $0.31 floor held through the OpenRouter routing-table refresh windows.
outcome_ja: 週次で更新されるLPU-v3キャパシティ台帳。Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235Bについて1ラックあたり毎秒38,420トークン以上を18拠点全体で確保し、OpenRouterのルーティング表更新ウィンドウを通じて0.31ドルの下限価格を保持する。
outcome_es: Un ledger semanal de capacidad LPU-v3 que fija al menos 38.420 tokens por segundo por rack para Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B en los 18 sitios y sostiene el piso de $0.31 a lo largo de las ventanas de refresco de la tabla de enrutamiento de OpenRouter.
outcome_fil: Lingguhang ina-update na LPU-v3 capacity ledger na nagpipirma ng hindi bababa sa 38,420 tokens-per-second per rack para sa Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B sa 18 sites na may $0.31 floor na napananatili sa buong OpenRouter routing-table refresh windows.
motivation: Once the lowest floor and lowest cold-start pair on a single trading day, every weekly routing-table refresh compounds share into the LPU-v3 leg; keeping that pair on the price sheet is the entire mechanism.
motivation_ja: 同一取引日に最低価格と最低コールドスタートが揃ったことで、週次のルーティング表更新ごとにLPU-v3側のシェアが累積する仕組みが成立しているため、その2つを価格表上に維持し続けることが施策全体の核となる。
motivation_es: Una vez que el piso mas bajo y el cold-start mas bajo coinciden en un mismo dia de operaciones, cada refresco semanal de la tabla de enrutamiento compone share hacia la pierna LPU-v3; sostener ese par en la lista de precios es todo el mecanismo.
motivation_fil: Sa sandaling magtugma ang pinakamababang floor at pinakamababang cold-start sa iisang trading day, ang bawat lingguhang routing-table refresh ay nag-iipon ng share patungo sa LPU-v3 leg; ang pagpapanatili ng pares na iyon sa price sheet ang buong mekanismo.

job: Tune the routing primitive so the lowest-latency-and-lowest-price endpoint inherits the cost-sensitive default leg on Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B without requiring per-tenant manual override.
job_ja: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235Bに関して、最低遅延かつ最低価格のエンドポイントがテナントごとの手動上書きなしにコスト感応型デフォルト脚を引き継ぐようルーティング・プリミティブを調整する。
job_es: Ajustar la primitiva de enrutamiento para que el endpoint de menor latencia y menor precio herede la pata por defecto sensible al costo en Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B sin requerir override manual por inquilino.
job_fil: I-tune ang routing primitive upang ang endpoint na pinakamababa sa latency at presyo ang manahin ang cost-sensitive default leg sa Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B nang hindi nangangailangan ng per-tenant manual override.
outcome: A platform-level Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B routing rule that promotes the LPU-v3 endpoint as the cost-sensitive default and exposes a customer-facing LPU-v3-preferred tier toggle behind the evals-on-the-fly primitive.
outcome_ja: プラットフォーム全体に適用されるQwen3.6-Max-Preview-235Bのルーティング規則。コスト感応型デフォルトとしてLPU-v3エンドポイントを採用し、evals-on-the-flyプリミティブ配下に顧客向け「LPU-v3優先」ティアのトグルを提示する。
outcome_es: Una regla de enrutamiento a nivel de plataforma para Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B que promueve el endpoint LPU-v3 como default sensible al costo y expone un toggle de nivel preferente LPU-v3 cara al cliente detras de la primitiva evals-on-the-fly.
outcome_fil: Isang platform-level Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B routing rule na nag-pro-promote sa LPU-v3 endpoint bilang cost-sensitive default at naglalantad ng customer-facing LPU-v3-preferred tier toggle sa likod ng evals-on-the-fly primitive.
motivation: The five-provider cohort carried the integration cycle, but the dashboard rewards whichever leg holds the lowest-latency-and-lowest-price pair; the routing algorithm has to encode that reward without operator handholding.
motivation_ja: 5プロバイダ群が統合サイクルを支えたとはいえ、ダッシュボードは最低遅延・最低価格を併せ持つ脚を報酬する設計であり、その報酬関数をオペレーターの手介入なしにルーティング・アルゴリズム側に書き込む必要がある。
motivation_es: El grupo de cinco proveedores cargo el ciclo de integracion, pero el dashboard recompensa la pata que sostiene el par de menor latencia y menor precio; el algoritmo de enrutamiento debe codificar esa recompensa sin asistencia manual.
motivation_fil: Dinala ng five-provider cohort ang integration cycle, pero ang dashboard ang gumagantimpala sa leg na may pinakamababang latency at presyo; kailangan i-encode ng routing algorithm ang gantimpalang iyon nang walang operator handholding.

job: Close the LPU-v3 latency and price gap on Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B by landing a fused-router kernel inside vLLM v0.11.6 or v0.12.x and re-pricing the cohort hosted-endpoint sheet before Q4 2026.

job_es: Cerrar la brecha de latencia y precio de LPU-v3 en Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B integrando un kernel de router fusionado en vLLM v0.11.6 o v0.12.x y reajustando la lista de precios de endpoints hospedados de la cohorte antes de Q4 2026.
job_fil: Isara ang latency at price gap ng LPU-v3 sa Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B sa pamamagitan ng pag-land ng fused-router kernel sa loob ng vLLM v0.11.6 o v0.12.x at pag-reprice sa cohort hosted-endpoint sheet bago ang Q4 2026.
outcome: A vLLM fused-router kernel release plus a coordinated Together AI, Fireworks AI, and DeepInfra hosted-endpoint repricing that brings the cohort blended first-token-latency below 0.1 seconds and matches the $0.31 per million floor.
outcome_ja: vLLMの融合ルータ・カーネル・リリースに加え、Together AI・Fireworks AI・DeepInfraが協調してホスト型エンドポイント価格を改定し、群の合成ファースト・トークン遅延を0.1秒未満に押し下げ、100万トークンあたり0.31ドルの下限価格に追随させる。
outcome_es: Una release del kernel de router fusionado en vLLM mas una reajuste coordinado de precios de endpoints hospedados de Together AI, Fireworks AI y DeepInfra que lleva la latencia de primer token mezclada de la cohorte por debajo de 0,1 segundos y empareja el piso de $0.31 por millon.
outcome_fil: Isang vLLM fused-router kernel release kasama ang coordinated Together AI, Fireworks AI, at DeepInfra hosted-endpoint repricing na nagbababa sa cohort blended first-token-latency sa ibaba ng 0.1 segundo at tumutugma sa $0.31 per million floor.
motivation: Holding routed share at the 35 to 45 percent band keeps the cohort relevant on the Q4 2026 dashboard; failing to close the latency gap concedes the default-routing tier and triples the share-shift slope.
motivation_ja: ルーティング・シェアを35〜45%帯に踏みとどまらせれば群はQ4 2026ダッシュボード上で意味を持ち続けられる。遅延差を縮められなければデフォルト・ルーティング・ティアを譲り、シェア・シフトの勾配は3倍に跳ね上がる。
motivation_es: Sostener el share enrutado en la banda de 35 a 45 por ciento mantiene a la cohorte relevante en el dashboard de Q4 2026; no cerrar la brecha de latencia concede el nivel de enrutamiento por defecto y triplica la pendiente del corrimiento de share.
motivation_fil: Ang pagpapanatili ng routed share sa 35 hanggang 45 porsyentong banda ang nagpapanatiling relevant sa cohort sa Q4 2026 dashboard; ang hindi pagsasara sa latency gap ay nagsusuko sa default-routing tier at nagto-triple sa share-shift slope.

job: Reposition the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio price sheet and partner co-distribution terms after the $0.42 Thursday-flip was undercut by the LPU-v3 $0.31 floor on the same model card.
job_ja: 同一モデルカード上でLPU-v3の0.31ドルにより自社の木曜0.42ドルが下回られたことを受け、Alibaba Cloud Model Studioの価格表およびパートナー共同流通条件を再構築する。

job_fil: I-reposisyon ang price sheet at partner co-distribution terms ng Alibaba Cloud Model Studio matapos ma-undercut ng LPU-v3 na $0.31 floor ang $0.42 Thursday-flip sa parehong model card.
outcome: A revised Model Studio price sheet plus partner co-distribution terms positioning Qwen3.6-Max-Preview as a multi-endpoint open-weight reference, keeping at least one Alibaba-affiliated leg inside the OpenRouter cost-sensitive band.
outcome_ja: 改定されたModel Studio価格表とパートナー共同流通条件。Qwen3.6-Max-Previewをマルチ・エンドポイントのオープン重み参照モデルとして位置付け、少なくとも1本のAlibaba系列脚をOpenRouterのコスト感応型帯域に残す。
outcome_es: Una lista de precios revisada de Model Studio mas terminos de codistribucion con partners que posicionan Qwen3.6-Max-Preview como una referencia de pesos abiertos multi-endpoint, manteniendo al menos una pata afiliada a Alibaba dentro de la banda sensible al costo de OpenRouter.
outcome_fil: Isang rebisadong Model Studio price sheet kasama ang partner co-distribution terms na nag-poposisyon sa Qwen3.6-Max-Preview bilang multi-endpoint open-weight reference, na nag-iingat ng kahit isang Alibaba-affiliated leg sa loob ng OpenRouter cost-sensitive band.
motivation: If the Qwen3.6-Max-Preview brand becomes synonymous with one dedicated-silicon endpoint, the model team loses leverage with future co-distribution partners and the cohort-substitution narrative against Claude Opus 4.7 collapses to a single-vendor story.

motivation_es: Si la marca Qwen3.6-Max-Preview se vuelve sinonimo de un solo endpoint de silicio dedicado, el equipo del modelo pierde palanca con futuros partners de codistribucion y la narrativa de sustitucion de la cohorte frente a Claude Opus 4.7 colapsa a una historia de un solo proveedor.
motivation_fil: Kung magiging katumbas ang Qwen3.6-Max-Preview brand sa iisang dedicated-silicon endpoint, mawawalan ng leverage ang model team sa hinaharap na co-distribution partners at babagsak ang cohort-substitution narrative laban sa Claude Opus 4.7 sa single-vendor story.

actor: Enterprise developer-platform procurement lead at agentic-tool tenants on Cursor, Cline, Aider, and Continue.dev
actor_ja: Cursor・Cline・Aider・Continue.dev上のエージェント型ツール契約企業における開発者プラットフォーム購買責任者
actor_es: Lider de compras de plataformas de desarrollo en tenants de herramientas agenticas en Cursor, Cline, Aider y Continue.dev
actor_fil: Procurement lead ng enterprise developer-platform sa mga agentic-tool tenants sa Cursor, Cline, Aider, at Continue.dev
job: Approve the platform-level LPU-v3-preferred default on Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B inside enterprise contracts so the cost-sensitive routing decision lands at the platform rather than per-developer override.
job_ja: 企業契約上でQwen3.6-Max-Preview-235Bに関するLPU-v3優先のプラットフォーム・デフォルトを承認し、コスト感応型ルーティング判断を開発者ごとの上書きではなくプラットフォーム側で確定させる。
job_es: Aprobar el default preferente LPU-v3 a nivel de plataforma para Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B dentro de los contratos empresariales para que la decision de enrutamiento sensible al costo aterrice en la plataforma y no en el override por desarrollador.
job_fil: Aprubahan ang platform-level LPU-v3-preferred default sa Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B sa loob ng enterprise contracts upang ang cost-sensitive routing decision ay mapunta sa platform sa halip na per-developer override.
outcome: Signed enterprise platform agreements with at least two of Cursor, Cline, Aider, and Continue.dev marking the LPU-v3 endpoint as the platform-level Qwen3.6-Max-Preview default with documented FinOps acceptance.
outcome_ja: Cursor・Cline・Aider・Continue.devのうち少なくとも2社と締結する企業プラットフォーム契約。LPU-v3エンドポイントをQwen3.6-Max-Previewのプラットフォーム・レベル・デフォルトに指定し、FinOps側の受諾が文書化されている。
outcome_es: Acuerdos firmados de plataforma empresarial con al menos dos de Cursor, Cline, Aider y Continue.dev que marcan el endpoint LPU-v3 como default de Qwen3.6-Max-Preview a nivel de plataforma con aceptacion FinOps documentada.
outcome_fil: Mga nilagdaang enterprise platform agreements sa hindi bababa sa dalawa sa Cursor, Cline, Aider, at Continue.dev na nagmamarka sa LPU-v3 endpoint bilang platform-level Qwen3.6-Max-Preview default na may dokumentadong FinOps acceptance.
motivation: The substitute-for-Claude-Opus-4.7 storyline only sticks if the agentic-tool platform defaults route to the cheapest fast endpoint; without procurement sign-off the substitution stays per-developer toggling and the share-shift stalls.
motivation_ja: Claude Opus 4.7代替のナラティブが定着するには、エージェント型ツールのプラットフォーム・デフォルトが最も安価で高速なエンドポイントへ向かう必要がある。購買部門の承認がなければ代替は開発者ごとのトグルに留まり、シェア・シフトは失速する。
motivation_es: La narrativa de sustitucion de Claude Opus 4.7 solo se sostiene si los defaults de las plataformas de herramientas agenticas enrutan al endpoint mas rapido y barato; sin el sign-off de compras la sustitucion queda en alternancia por desarrollador y el corrimiento de share se estanca.
motivation_fil: Ang substitute-for-Claude-Opus-4.7 storyline ay magtatagal lamang kung ang platform defaults ng agentic-tool ay rumi-route sa pinakamabilis at pinakamurang endpoint; kung walang sign-off ng procurement, mananatili sa per-developer toggling ang substitution at hihinto ang share-shift.
